content.title: Airline CEOs meet with VP Vance to discuss shutdown impacts
content.description:
As the US government shutdown has continued for nearly a month, major airline executives met with Vice President JD Vance at the White House on Thursday to communicate how the shutdown could impact the industry if it drags on further.

Yahoo Finance senior reporter Pras Subramanian comes on Market Domination to discuss the roundtable event, which included United Airlines (UAL) CEO Scott Kirby, American Airlines (AAL) CEO Robert Isom, and several union leaders.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.

content.title: Airlines cutting fare is 'putting pressure' on low-cost carriers
content.description:
United Airlines (UAL) saw revenue from its premium business grow by 6% in the operator's third quarter, similar to Delta Air Lines' (DAL) own earnings boost it saw in thanks to premium travel bookings.

Bloomberg Intelligence senior aerospace defense and airlines industry analyst George Ferguson comes on Market Catalysts to discuss how larger airlines are cutting airfare prices to better compete with low-cost carriers.

Also catch George Ferguson explain why he believes United may have overloaded its capacity this past quarter.

content.title: Gov't shutdown could have lasting effects on airlines. Here's why.
content.description:
The airline industry could see long-term impacts from the government shutdown, Raymond James managing director Savi Syth tells Yahoo Finance. Syth explains that while the government is shut down, there isn't air traffic controller training, another headwind for a workforce that is already in short supply.

Also catch what Hickory Global Partners president Chris Dane has to say about shutdown pressures airline operators could be faced with, all this coming after Delta Air Lines (DAL) topped third quarter earnings estimates.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.

content.title: What could push airlines to tipping point if US shutdown drags on
content.description:
Delta Air Lines (DAL) stock is lifting off on Thursday after topping third quarter estimates: revenue of $15.2 billion (vs. estimates of $15.1 billion) and adjusted earnings of $1.71 per share (vs. estimates of $1.56). As the US government's shutdown moves into its ninth day, what sort of disruptions could airline operators see in the coming days if the shutdown drags on longer?

Hickory Global Partners president and managing partner Chris Dane and Yahoo Finance senior reporter Pras Subramanian weigh in.
